newsitem.title: USA: Coopers & Lybrand makes tax management changes.
newsitem.headline: Coopers & Lybrand makes tax management changes.

text.p: Auditing and professional services firm Coopers & Lybrand said it named Samuel DiPiazza Jr. the vice chairman for its tax line of business.
He succeeds Alan LeBovidge, who was named partner in charge of Coopers & Lybrand's national tax practice.
DiPiazza now heads a 3,000-member division, which contributed 20 percent of Coopers & Lybrand's domestic revenues of $2.1 billion in 1996, the firm said in a statement.
Coopers & Lybrand, a private partnership, said Rocco Maggiotto replaces DiPiazza as the client service vice chairman and managing partner of the firm's New York offices.
